Subject: Elsmere Inns - Referral Required

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the Elsmere Inns submission. I've reviewed the materials and appreciate how complete everything is.

This account requires referral to senior underwriting due to two factors: hospitality risks need additional review under our guidelines, and the five-year loss history exceeds $250K. 

Before I escalate this, can you help me with a few questions?

• What loss control measures has the insured implemented recently?
• Can you provide details on the largest losses and any corrective actions taken?
• Are there any unique exposures across the three locations we should know about?

If this doesn't fit our timeline, I'd recommend reaching out to a hospitality specialist, one that may be better suited for this risk.

Let me know how you'd like to proceed.

Best,
[Underwriter name]
